description: German (Germany) terminology, register, and audit allowlist for the AlgaPSA de locale.

domainTerms.notes: Use Konto (neuter: das Konto, die Konten) for user, MSP, and customer accounts. Keep Account only inside established product or provider names.
Use Termin (der Termin) for calendar appointments and appointment requests; use Terminplanung when the scheduling process is meant.
Use Genehmigung for approval workflows, requests, and timesheets. Freigabe occurs occasionally in the current files; reserve it for release/clearance contexts.
Use Asset (neuter: das Asset, die Assets) for managed devices, inventory, and configuration assets. Vermögenswert is a financial asset and is inconsistent with the dominant MSP usage.
Use Zuweisung for assigning tickets, tasks, users, or technicians; use zuweisen for the action.
Use for workflow automation and automated operational behavior.
Use Abrechnung for the billing product area, billing settings, and charge calculation. Do not use Rechnung for the area; Rechnung is an invoice.
Keep Board as the established UI loanword (neuter: das Board, die Boards) for ticket and kanban boards. Never use Vorstand, which means a corporate board of directors.

Use Stundenkontingent for prepaid or retainer hour pools and Verbrauchskontingent for consumption pools. Current contract/report/catalog files establish Kontingent; literal Eimer and untranslated Bucket remnants are inconsistent.
Use Budget (neuter: das Budget) only for project or financial spending limits. A sales quote is an Angebot.
Use Kunde/Kunden for customer organizations and client-portal users. Client appears in a few current strings but is not the dominant user-facing term.
Use the closed compound Kundenportal for the customer-facing app.
Use Kommentar for ticket, project, task, and document comments; use kommentieren for the action.
Use Kontakt for a CRM contact record; Kontaktperson is acceptable when the person rather than the record must be explicit.
Use Vertrag for service contracts, contract templates, and contract lines.
Use Vertragslinie for the billable service entity associated with a contract. The current locale also contains Vertragszeile and Vertragsposition; keep the glossary term consistent in new copy.
Use Gutschrift for a credit record applied to an invoice and Guthaben for the resulting available balance. Kredit and Credits occur in headings, but Gutschrift dominates operational actions.
Keep Dashboard as the established German software loanword (neuter: das Dashboard).
Use Einsatzplanung for the technician scheduling/dispatch workspace (Dynamics convention). Use Disposition only for the organizational function or the dispatcher role. Adversarial review 2026-08.
Use Dokument for uploaded documents, folders, sharing, and document management.
Always spell the noun E-Mail with a hyphen and capitals; use E-Mails in the plural.
Use E-Mail-Adresse for an address field and E-Mail-Adressen for the plural section heading.
Use E-Mail-Typ for the label/type picker on an email row, matching the established contacts namespace.
Use Erweiterung for platform/product extensions and installed extension metadata.
Use Datei for uploaded and generated files; use Ordner for folders.
Use Filter (masculine: der Filter) as the UI noun and filtern for the action.

Use Auslieferung for the sales-order fulfillment column and the matching customer-document label; Direktversand and Aus Bestand are its values. Lieferart means shipping method and is a different concept.
Use Branche for the client/CRM business-sector field. Industrie is narrower and usually means manufacturing.
Use Rechnung for customer invoices and Rechnungsentwurf for draft invoice. Do not use Abrechnung for the invoice entity.
Use Rechnungsstellung for the invoice-generation process. Fakturierung appears once in the billing navigation and is an existing inconsistency.
Keep Job for the background-job entity (der Job, die Jobs), as established in msp/jobs and msp/core. Use Auftrag only for import/export work orders and never Beruf for a background job.
Use Wissensdatenbank for KB articles, categories, and review flows.
Use Lizenz for software licensing, seats, and activation.
Use Standort for client, inventory, and service locations; use Ort only for a general place.
Use Meilenstein for project milestones and milestone billing schedules.
Use Mobil for the compact phone-type label and Mobiltelefon when the field needs an explicit noun.
Use Benachrichtigung for in-app and email notifications.

Keep Onboarding as the established MSP loanword and form compounds such as Onboarding-Assistent and Onboarding-Checkliste with a hyphen. Einrichtung is suitable only when setup, not customer onboarding, is meant.
Use Zahlung for invoice payments, online payments, and payment status.
Use Kommissionierliste for the warehouse pick list and kommissioniert for a picked line, including the Kommissioniert von signature note. Erledigt (done) is not specific enough.
Use Pipeline (die Pipeline) for the CRM sales pipeline. Never Gaspipeline or any physical-conduit word.
Use Primäre E-Mail as a label and primäre E-Mail in running text; keep adjective agreement when case changes.
Use Priorität for ticket, task, and workflow priority labels.
Use Fortschritt for progress labels and indicators; the all-caps micro-label is FORTSCHRITT.
Use Projekt for project management, phases, tasks, budgets, and project templates.
Use Angebot (neuter: das Angebot, die Angebote) for sales/service quotes. Never Zitat, which means a textual quotation.

Use Satz for a priced rate column on customer documents; it covers hourly, per-unit, and flat rates. Keep Einzelpreis for unit price so the two columns stay distinguishable, and use Stundensatz only where the rate is explicitly hourly.
Use Bericht for analytics, operational, billing, and audit reports.
Use Anfrage for service, approval, and appointment requests; use anfordern only for the action of requesting something.
Use Zeitplan for a schedule as a general entity and planen for the action. Dispatch entries are Termineinträge in the current locale; calendar-specific copy may use Terminplan.
Use Bildschirm for a UI screen, as established in account and integrations copy; use Ansicht when the source means a view rather than the physical/display metaphor.

Use Dienst for catalog items, managed services, and support services; the current files also use Service frequently, especially in project, quote, and client copy. Prefer Dienst in new generic labels but preserve branded service names.
Use the closed compound Servicekatalog for the billing/service catalog product area. Dienstkatalog and untranslated Service catalog occur in isolated current strings.
Use plural Einstellungen for settings pages and controls.
Keep Single Sign-On as the established feature name and SSO as the abbreviation; preserve capitalization in titles.
Keep SLA as the standard abbreviation; use SLA-Vereinbarung only when the expanded entity must be explicit.
Keep Status (masculine: der Status); the plural is also Status, not Statusse.
Use Umfrage for satisfaction surveys, templates, and response analytics.
Keep Tag (neuter: das Tag, die Tags) for metadata labels. Schlagwort occurs in a minority of current strings and should not be introduced into new UI copy.
Use Aufgabe for project tasks, workflow tasks, and task inbox items; do not confuse it with the background Job entity.

Use the neutral Steuer for tax labels on invoices, quotes, and sales orders. Name a specific levy (Umsatzsteuer, Mehrwertsteuer) only where that levy is actually meant, because a tenant may charge a different one.
Use Techniker for field/service technicians and technician assignment; use Technikerin when an explicitly feminine person is meant.

Use Mandant (der Mandant, die Mandanten) for tenant — final product-owner decision 2026-08-05: Microsoft de-DE terminology (Entra/M365 admin UI), and AlgaPSA tenant strings live almost entirely in Microsoft-integration screens where technicians see Mandant daily. The professional-services reading (client of a lawyer/accountant) is contained by that context. Tenant ID, Tenant-ID and provider-branded concepts stay untranslated.
Keep Ticket as the MSP support term (neuter: das Ticket, die Tickets). Never Fahrkarte or Eintrittskarte, which refer to travel/admission tickets.
Use Zeiteintrag for one billable time record. Zeiterfassung is dominant in navigation and can mean the overall time-tracking feature; current namespaces mix both senses.

Use Stundenzettel for grouped/submitted time entries and approval flows. The current msp/time-entry file also uses Arbeitszeitnachweis and Zeiterfassung; keep Stundenzettel for the entity. Arbeitszeitnachweis is an acceptable formal synonym (Microsoft uses both); Arbeitszeittabelle also appears in the files and should converge on Stundenzettel.
Use Einzelpreis for the per-unit price column. Never reuse it for rate, which is Satz; a document that shows both columns must keep them distinguishable.
Use Benutzer for application users and Benutzerin when an explicitly feminine person is meant.
Keep Webhook as the technical loanword (der Webhook, die Webhooks).
Use Geschäftlich for the work phone-type label, matching all current contact label sets.

Keep Workflow as the established software loanword (der Workflow, die Workflows). AlgaPSA-Workflows sind ereignisgesteuerte Automatisierung im Stil von n8n (Trigger, Aktionen, Ausführungen), keine Jira-artigen Statusabläufe.

Literal translation of billing bucket; Eimer means a physical pail. Use Stundenkontingent or Verbrauchskontingent.

Wrong sense for a support ticket; Fahrkarte means a travel ticket.
A gas pipeline; the CRM sales pipeline is just Pipeline.
Informal second-person singular; the register is Sie-Form.

User-facing multi-tenant copy uses Mandant (Microsoft de-DE convention; finale Produktentscheidung 2026-08-05). Tenant ID bleibt unverändert.
Plural: die Mandanten.
Financial-asset sense; managed IT devices and configuration assets use Asset.
Plural financial-asset sense; managed IT assets use Assets.

dialectRules.rule: Address users consistently with formal Sie/Ihr forms; never use du/dein forms in user-facing copy.
dialectRules.notes: Formal forms heavily dominate the de files (for example, common.json uses „Aktualisieren Sie …“). Legacy du strings remain mainly in client-portal.json, features/tickets.json, and common.json and are inconsistencies, not precedent.

dialectRules.rule: Capitalize every German noun, including nouns inside labels and compounds.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: Rechnung, Zeiteintrag, Kundenportal, E-Mail-Adresse. Preserve brand casing and all-uppercase abbreviations.

dialectRules.rule: Prefer idiomatic German compounds and use linking hyphens around abbreviations or English loanword components where readability requires them.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: Kundenportal, Servicekatalog, Stundenkontingent, E-Mail-Adresse, SLA-Vereinbarung, Onboarding-Assistent. Avoid English-style spaced noun stacks.

dialectRules.rule: Keep Ticket for support work and translate a sales quote as Angebot.
dialectRules.notes: Ticket is neuter (das Ticket); Angebot is neuter (das Angebot). Travel/admission terms and Zitat are forbidden.

dialectRules.rule: Keep Abrechnung (billing), Rechnung (invoice), Rechnungsstellung (invoicing), and Gutschrift (credit) distinct.
dialectRules.notes: These entities coexist in the billing UI and must not collapse into Rechnung or Kredit indiscriminately.

dialectRules.rule: Retain established German MSP/software loanwords and give them normal German articles and plural forms.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: das Asset/die Assets, das Board/die Boards, das Dashboard, der Job/die Jobs, das Ticket/die Tickets, der Workflow/die Workflows, der Webhook/die Webhooks.

dialectRules.rule: Preserve every {{variable}} exactly as in the English source.
dialectRules.notes: Do not translate placeholders, braces, or variable names.

exact: phase_name, task_description, assigned_to, estimated_hours, due_date, priority, service, task_type, status, tags
identicalAllowlist.notes: This allowlist is intentionally conservative; audit tooling should report English-identical German strings unless they match one of these exact values, case-insensitive established loanwords, or technical patterns.
